environment.description: Go microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default configuration. The ALB performs TLS termination and forwards traffic directly to the container on port 8080. No additional middleware or security headers are injected. The LDAP server (OpenLDAP 2.4) is accessible on the internal VPC at ldap.internal:389 with no query restrictions or access control lists beyond bind authentication. The service account cn=svc-directory has read access to all attributes including userPassword across the entire ou=employees subtree.

config.network: ALB -> container:8080, LDAP on internal VPC port 389
config.ldap_acl: service account has subtree read on ou=employees including userPassword
